info.title: Meeting Notetaker API
info.description: Cookie-session API. State-changing requests require the `X-CSRF-Token` header (value from GET /api/v1/me). All errors use the envelope `{ error: { code, message, requestId } }`.

get.summary: Start sign-in with Google or Microsoft (redirect)

post.summary: DEVELOPMENT ONLY: sign in as a local test user (disabled in production)

get.summary: Current user, settings and CSRF token

patch.summary: Update timezone, auto-registration preference, or acknowledge the recording notice

post.summary: Start calendar authorization (separate consent from sign-in). Returns the URL to navigate to.

delete.summary: Disconnect a calendar (revokes and deletes tokens)

get.summary: List the current user's meetings (paginated, filterable)

post.summary: Register a meeting for recording: an existing synced meeting ({meetingId}) or an ad-hoc Meet/Teams link. Idempotent.

delete.summary: Request deletion of a meeting and all its recordings/derived data (asynchronous)

post.summary: Cancel recording before the bot is in the meeting

get.summary: Recording metadata and authorized playback/download URLs

post.summary: Generate (or explicitly regenerate) the summary. Idempotent while a generation is in flight.

202.description: Generation queued or already in progress

get.summary: Minutes of Meeting (MoM) for the meeting

post.summary: Generate (or explicitly regenerate) the minutes. Idempotent while a generation is in flight.

202.description: Generation queued or already in progress

get.summary: Provider health, job status counts and queue depth

post.summary: Retry a failed (dead-lettered) job. Handlers are idempotent.
